messages:
pagerduty: ALERT: P2 - autoscaler errors + request failures for hosted-models. Symptoms: rising 95p latency, increased 502/503 on long context jobs. See INC-1900 dashboard https://pd.example/inc/INC-1900 :rotating_light:
maya: acked. I'm oncall. starting a quick triage. who can pull the autoscaler and pod statuses?
jonah: grabbing pods/hpa now. quick note: no release in last 2 hours.
li: pulling cluster quota + pool view. initial peek shows gpupool-usw2 at capacity and several warmup jobs stuck in Init.
priya: running the warmup logs tail and searching for OOM or device allocation errors.

jonah: initial timeline bullets (short):
- 1899001080 alert threshold crossed (95p > 1.5s)
- 1899001102 HPA target increased from 40 -> 90
- 1899001125 many new pods enter Pending due to InsufficientGPUs

li: autoscaler excerpt (copied):
```
[autoscaler] 2026-03-15T10:05:30Z pool=gpupool-usw2 used=64 capacity=64 queue=180 launch_rate=2/min
[autoscaler] 2026-03-15T10:07:00Z pending_pods=32, warmup_avg=28s
```

priya: warmup tail shows repeated errors: "device busy" and slow plugin loads. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:06:40Z] warmup: load_shard shard=3 take=12.3s plugin-init=9.1s
[2026-03-15T10:06:51Z] warmup: error device busy, retrying
[2026-03-15T10:06:58Z] warmup: succeeded after 20s
```

maya: hypotheses (short):
H1: GPU pool capacity exhausted (soft quota or noisy neighbor) -> Pending pods -> HPA keeps scaling -> overload on ready pods -> latency/5xxs.
H2: warmup path got slower (plugin init/plugin GC) causing long readiness times, adding to pending backlog.
H3: launch_rate cap in autoscaler too low, cooldown prevents rapid replenishment.
H4: routing rules forced exact model match, blocking fallback to a smaller quantized variant.

infra-bot: runbook:autoscale suggested mitigations: 1) increase pool (cloud request), 2) temporary eviction of non-critical GPU workloads, 3) enable model-fallback flag for low-priority traffic.

maya: immediate mitigations applied:
- evicted staging/experiments pods from gpupool-usw2 (freed ~6 GPUs) at 1899001200
- enabled model_fallback for default-route (only non-SAML tenants) at 1899001230
- increased autoscaler aggressive_launch annotation to 4/min at 1899001250

jonah: commands run (audit):
```
kubectl get pods -n model-prod -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, phase:.status.phase, node:.spec.nodeName}' | egrep 'Pending|Init'
kubectl describe hpa model-prod-hpa -n model-prod
```

li: cloud-capacity contact: requesting +10 GPUs from us-west-2; quoted ETA 25m pending infra-lead approval. I've opened ticket CC infra-leads.
priya: after evictions+fallback, 95p dropped from 1.8s -> 550ms over ~6m. Error rate for long-context calls reduced but still ~2%. Warmup backlog reduced from 180 -> 60.

maya: collecting artifacts: please upload kube events, autoscaler logs, warmup logs, and sample trace ids to gs://redwood-incident-logs/INC-1900/ . Use folder "raw" and keep filenames short.

jonah: uploaded kube-events.json, autoscaler.log, and hpa-metrics.csv to GCS link (internal): https://storage.internal/INC-1900/raw/
priya: added warmup traces + sample request ids: trace-abc123, trace-def456.

maya: updating hypothesis tracking table (in-thread):
- H1: data -> autoscaler logs show used=64/64, pending pods 32. evidence=strong.
- H2: data -> warmup avg increased and plugin-init spikes. evidence=moderate. need warmup binary build id + recent changes.
- H3: data -> autoscaler config shows launch_rate=2/min, aggressive_launch annotation not set prior to mitigation. evidence=weak->moderate.
- H4: data -> routing policy blocked fallback (policy yaml shows exact-match flag). evidence=moderate.

maya: owners for RCA items:
- warmup perf + binary check -> priya
- autoscaler config + cooldowns -> jonah
- routing policy + fallback history -> maya
- capacity automation + quota -> li

[HANDOFF] 1899001420 maya -> jonah: maya has to join customer call, handing lead to jonah until 1899001620. notes: evictions done, fallback enabled, autoscaler override in place; continue to monitor.
jonah: taking over. will keep 5m updates.

jonah: 5m check @1899001500: queue=48, gpupool used=58/74 (cloud provisioning + evictions), launch_rate=4/min, error_rate=1.6% on long-context.
li: cloud reply: +10 GPUs approved, provisioning started; ETA ~22m.
priya: warmup profiling: warmup binary is v2.4.3 deployed 2026-03-01. I've pulled JVM/py GC traces and saw increased heap churn in plugin load path. attaching flamegraphs to GCS.

maya: noting follow-ups for RCA and fixes: ACTION-470 (warmup memory leak investigation), ACTION-471 (increase default autoscaler launch_rate or make it workload-aware), ACTION-472 (allow configurable fallback per route), ACTION-473 (quota alerting to runbook). Owners as per above.

jonah: closing mitigation note: impact window approx 1899001080 -> 1899001500. Primary mitigation effective: evictions + fallback + autoscaler aggressive_launch. Cloud GPUs expected to finish provisioning; permanent fixes to be covered in RCA.

maya: thanks team. I'll pull this thread into the incident ticket and draft the RCA. Please add any missing logs to the GCS folder. :white_check_mark:
